description: EMSC (European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre) earthquake information is a hazard data portal run by European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC), a non-profit organisation. EMSC collects and disseminates earthquake parameters from more than 70 member institutes and crowdsourced eyewitness reports (felt reports), offers queries through its website, and alerts through mobile apps. Coverage: Euro-Mediterranean region, with events worldwide. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: terms and privacy policy pages exist; not read. Caveats: the page does not name download formats or a web-service address; recent events are preliminary and revised by contributing institutes. It can support near-real-time and historical earthquake inputs for European and Mediterranean infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here.
